title: Chapter 427
paragraphs: Chapter 427
Episode 124. Crisis for the Elders (1)
After the Ghost Unit left, Murakan couldn't control his anger.
He had dreamt of a happy time with Strawberry Pie, but once again, the situation had gone as the 'damn little brat' predicted.
Over a hundred Guardian Knights raided Jin's private training ground.
The number couldn't possibly be considered just a warning to Jin and the Ghost Unit, so Murakan unleashed his rage upon seeing them.
The sky was filled with dark energy, and Jin's personal training ground was destroyed with just a few breaths from Murakan, leaving the ceiling pierced.
The Guardian Knights, those who ordered them, and even the five hundred mercenaries who were watching the grumpy black dragon on the training ground's dirt floor were all taken aback.
In an unexpected turn of events, Murakan quickly subdued the Guardian Knights.

For the Guardian Knights, it was better to be suppressed to some extent. Although they had orders from Mu and Anne, they judged that fighting to the death against the family guardian spirit because of the Ghost Unit was a crazy idea.
From the beginning, Mu and Anne didn't think that Murakan would be guarding the Ghost Unit mercenaries.
"Hey, you damn bastards! Didn't you see me at first and surrender? Huh? Fix your heads straight, straight! Neither you nor I will sleep tonight. Got it? This damn..."
After the Ghost Unit left safely, a bizarre scene unfolded in the courtyard of the Sword Garden.
Murakan was scolding the Guardian Knights who had attacked him.
"One, to the great black dragon, two, do not mess with it. You in front, you do it. One."
"To... the great black dragon."
"Two."
"Do not... mess with it."
It was an unrealistic scene, but no one dared to stop Murakan. If Jin was doing this, it might be different, but Murakan was somewhat uncomfortable for everyone in the family.
And there were people watching this scene and getting furious from the window of the main house.
"Ha! Seriously, there's no mess like this. Can the Sword Garden be reduced to this mess?"
"Older brother, this is really not right. Not only the youngest, but also that strange black dragon!"
Mu and Anne were on the verge of losing their temper as they watched the unexpected outcome and scolding from Joshua's room.
Joshua didn't respond to his siblings' angry voices and remained lost in thought.
'Did the youngest really anticipate everything, just because Mu and Anne caused a little trouble?'
Judgment that couldn't be described as just cautious. Along with bold actions and repercussions that always stirred up the family.
Although his face was expressionless, Joshua felt anxious.
He felt as if the youngest had already caught up to him. The youngest, who seemed like he could be crushed to death at any moment, no longer existed.
"From now on, when dealing with the youngest, think twice before you act."
As Joshua spoke, Mu and Anne's eyes widened. It was a completely unexpected response.
"Big brother?"
"What's that?"
"It means the two of you are thoughtlessly poking at a beehive. Trying to provoke the Tona brothers would only make you look foolish."
Watching Mu and Anne grit their teeth, Joshua smiled softly.
"And your reputation also affects me."
Mu and Anne looked up at Joshua, startled.
Luna, who always disapproved of them; Runtya, who was only annoyed no matter how much they showed affection; the scornful Dephus and Mary; Ran and Vugo, who had no interest in each other.
Among the Sonwi siblings, only Joshua had taken care of them and acknowledged them. It had been a long time since Joshua spoke so coldly.
"We're sorry, big brother."
"We'll do better from now on."
"…Alright. Our job is to straighten out the family that he messed up. And we shouldn't poke around anymore. We need to build up our strength and wait for the right time to wage an all-out war."
"Yes."
"We will keep that in mind."
"It's best not to lose our composure, no matter what he does."
"We understand, big brother."
Joshua shifted his gaze out the window. Watching Murakan discipline the guardian knights seemed to make his head throb.
'So, the Phantom Troupe... Another fight between the youngest and the Elders' Council, I suppose.'
Joshua was aware that the Elders' Council had hired the Phantom Troupe to assassinate Jin.

'The request failed, and instead, some kind of relationship formed between Jin and the Phantom Troupe. Then, the Troupe should either silence or deal with the clients. I'm curious how Jordan, the Elders' Chairman, will solve this.'
Black Sword Chairman Jordan Luncandel.
Joshua was hoping that Jin would spend his energy fighting with Jordan, and ultimately defeat him. Then, Jordan would be the first to reach out to him.
November 16, 1799, a villa in the eastern part of Hufester.

A group of old men sat on an open terrace, looking out at the beach. The large, round wooden table was filled with luxurious gambling cards, and the hands that held them looked incredibly strong and full of energy, belying the old age of their owners.
"Damn, the cards aren't working for me."
"At this rate, you'll lose your pension as well. Are you feeling uneasy? You're playing too aggressively."
"I can't stop thinking about the Phantom Troupe leader visiting the 12th generation. I hope he didn't inform the 12th generation about our request."

"What if he did? Neither the 12th generation nor the Phantom Troupe can mess with us. They would risk turning the entire Luncandel family against them. And if word got out that they sold out their client, the Phantom Troupe's reputation would plummet. No one would use them."
"The Phantom Troupe leader wouldn't do something so foolish."
"Hmm, is that so?"
"Anyway, I was planning to have a conversation with the Elder Council soon, so let's wait a little longer."
They were the elders of Runcandel.
Elders were a class that didn't need to take separate vacations or reside in the Sword Garden unless under special circumstances.
Some were dedicated to training for martial arts improvement, some were protecting their positions in the Sword Garden, and some, like these, enjoyed leisure and pleasure in their remaining years.

There were more than a few high-ranking courtesans who only served those with power above the Bement royal family, and bottles of alcohol, worth hundreds of gold coins per bottle, lay scattered on the floor.
"How about stopping here, Elder?"
"Right, let's go to the beach and cool our heads a bit."
At that moment, as the women spoke, the elders' eyes changed.
"Shh, be quiet."

The elders, who stood up simultaneously, looked toward the pitch-black sea. Although only the sound of the crashing waves could be heard from the moonless night sea, the elders sensed another presence hidden within.
"What is it, a boat?"
The beach where the elders' villa was located was not a place that could be accessed by ordinary people.
"It won't be a lost fisherman. Anyone have a guess as to who..."
Thud!
A dagger suddenly appeared and pierced the back of the elder's neck who was speaking. The woman who held the dagger was the one who suggested going to the beach.
At that moment, the remaining elders attempted to stab the woman but were stopped by a group of assailants that suddenly emerged from the floor of the terrace.
"Everyone seems to be playing too carelessly, touching a figure whom even my brother revered as a monster."
The woman removed the 'mask' that covered her entire body and revealed her true appearance. As Fei Prochi shrugged her shoulders, another elder's neck fell.
The elders were all skilled survivors from Runcandel, but their habits and complacency had dulled their swords.
The constant entertainment in the same place, the arrogance that no assassin would dare touch a Runcandel elder.
Today, the reason the elders were caught off guard by the Phantom Troupe was precisely that.
Eventually, when Lata revealed his appearance, the veins in the elders' necks bulged.
"Phantom Troupe leader...!"
"You crazy bastard!"
"As expected, it doesn't give me the chills at all."
Click, Lata lit a cigarette and looked at the surrounded elders.

Just like when Fei attacked Jin a while ago, the inside of the villa was already filled with paralyzing poison. In addition, dozens of snipers deployed around the area had aimed their poisoned arrows at the elders' limbs.
Despite this, some particularly outstanding elders showed their vigor by emitting various auras. However, even when they were perfectly healthy, they were no match for Lata.
Considering Lata led the elite ghost agents, the moment they allowed infiltration, death was inevitable.
"Chills? What... are you talking about, Ghost Captain?"
"You guys don't feel the chilling sensation you had when facing the 12th generation."

"Do you think you'll be safe after this? Even if you kill us, the fact that you accepted our request is already documented. The Council of Elders and Runcandel! We will annihilate you. Gwigok Castle will vanish without a trace!"
The elders did not beg for their lives. They shouted confidently that the ghost agents would also meet their end.
"I chose the right person. You don't seem scared at all."
"Are you talking about the 12th generation?"

"Yes. Why do you think I went all the way to the Sword Garden to find the 12th generation? It was to join forces with them. Blame your own carelessness and incompetence for not preparing even after seeing that. The background of Runcandel occasionally makes people this stupid."
"Nenoom!"
Swish-!
As Lata began swinging the ghost, the elders' heads fell off.
After killing all the elders with the agents, Lata said this:
"Take only the heads, and load the bodies onto the boat."
The next day, at the Council of Elders' chamber.
"...Nearly ten elders were found headless. What on earth is going on?"
"This is an insult and challenge to Runcandel! Find out who they are, who's behind them! Make sure they pay the price in blood!"
"Who are the crazy ones who did this..."
Almost all the elders gathered and discussed the assassination that had occurred overnight. Elder Jordan's figure was not seen.
"Chief Justice! Please say something. How should we, the elders, deal with this situation?"
Just as Lin Milcano was about to answer, clang!
The door of the Council of Elders' chamber opened, and a person appeared.
"Hello, elders."
The person who entered while greeting was none other than Jin. He carried a dark bundle on his shoulder and held a piece of paper in his hand.
As soon as Jin entered, the elders instinctively realized something was wrong.
"...What is that on your shoulder?"
As one of the elders asked with a trembling voice, Jin put the bundle down on the long table in the conference room. The heads of the dead elders rolled on the table.
"These are the heads of the elders who targeted me. This is a contract the dead elders entrusted to the ghost agents to assassinate me."
As Jin spoke calmly, most of the elders felt a cold and sharp sensation sweep across their backs.
It was a feeling they had forgotten for quite some time.
Fear.
